name: What is an in-law suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: An in-law suite is a self-contained living space, typically attached to or located on the same property as a primary residence. It usually includes a bedroom, bathroom, and sometimes a small kitchen or living area, designed to provide independent living for a family member while maintaining close proximity to the main home. These suites offer privacy and convenience for multi-generational living or adult children, without the full separation of a completely separate dwelling.
